The prices are as of January 2020, but here are some of the products purchased.

・AHC Peptide Active Real Eye Cream for Face: 5500W (about 500 yen)

I also purchased Mediheal's sheet mask, but I bought the D:NA Aqua Ring Mask x 1 and the P.D.F A.C Dressing Ampoule Mask x 2 together for 30,300W (2800 yen), so the price of each is unknown.

Because THE MASK SHOP was published in the guidebook, the store was quite crowded, but there was relatively space here.
You may need to ask the staff, as many are quite expensive, but they all basically speak Japanese.
There is no problem with the staff in the store. The attitude of the receptionist's brother was so bad that he let the product be thrown away. Maybe they were just tired of the influx of customers, but honestly it was quite unpleasant.
They gave me a receipt the first time I purchased it, but they didn't say "I don't have a receipt" the second time. I really wanted to convey the purpose of what I received earlier, but since I am a wholesaler, it is a pretty good addition.

Anyway, it may be good for those who want to buy it cheaply, but if you think like this, you want to buy it at the average price even if it is high.
